headline: NBS has just published the new rate for Monday: A change is coming, here is how much the euro and dollar will be worth!
summary: The National Bank of Serbia published the official middle exchange rate of the dinar against the euro for Monday at 117.3863 dinars.
why: The National Bank of Serbia sets the official dinar reference rate, which anchors exchange-rate settlements in Serbia.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: NBS upravo objavila novi kurs za ponedeljak: Sprema se promena, evo koliko će vredeti evro i dolar!
